{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Bean}} {{Character |type=First Order |image=[[File:Scorch-SWSM.png]] |option1=First Order |image2=[[File:JadBean-ROTJ.png]] |option2=Galactic Empire |name=Jad Bean |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Film|VI}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]''[[Return of the Jedi - The Film Novel]]'' |pronouns=He/him{{Film|VI}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]]''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' |feathers= |eyes=Green |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Navy]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|34|Helmets}} *[[First Order]]''[[TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' **[[Zeta Squadron]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Today, after years of training, we embark on our first official mission for the First Order. Because I've worked with each and every one of you, and did my best to transform you from a gang of grunts into a team of pilots, I know you're all eager to climb into your TIE fighters so we can fly off and make history. But before that happens, you'll have to stand at attention for another minute so I can tell you about the most important weapon at your disposal. And what I'm going to tell you is off the books, something that I doubt very much you've ever heard before.|Jad Bean delivers a speech to Zeta Squadron|}} '''Jad Bean''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial Navy Trooper]] on board the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] during its construction in the [[Endor system]]. In [[4 ABY]], Bean was on the [[battle station]]'s [[Overbridge (Death Star II)|overbridge]] when [[Captain]] [[Yorr]] of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|Imperial shuttle]] ''[[ST 321]]'' contacted him in order to land on board the [[Death Star]]. Bean deactivated the [[Space station|station's]] [[Deflector shield|shield]] to let the [[shuttle]] pass and was then ordered by [[Lieutenant]] [[Endicott]] to inform [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]] that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] had arrived on the [[Starship|shuttle]]. Bean survived the Death Star's destruction by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the [[Battle of Endor]] shortly after Vader's arrival and went on to join the [[First Order]], a successor to the Empire. He served as a [[flight instructor]] and led [[Zeta Squadron]] in a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]] as [[Zeta Leader]], going by the nickname '''Scorch''' and training with the group for [[Standard year|years]] before its first official mission. He then flew with the [[squadron]] against the [[Resistance]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar]] in [[34 ABY]]. ==Biography== ===An Imperial Bean=== {{Quote|Command station, this is ST-321, code clearance blue. We are starting our approach. Deactivate the security shield.''"
"''The security deflector shield will be deactivated when we have confirmation of your code transmission. Stand by.|Captain Yorr and Jad Bean|audio=Yorr-Bean-ROTJ.flac|}} [[File:BeanAtMonitor-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Jad Bean served on board the Death Star II, working as a shield operator and flight controller on the overbridge.]] Jad Bean was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Imperial Navy Trooper|trooper]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]]. he was [[Death Star Trooper|stationed]] on board the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] while it was under construction in the [[Endor system]]. Bean was manning a console in the [[Overbridge (Death Star II)|overbridge]]{{StoryCite|story=The Levers of Power|book=The Rise of the Empire}} control center, acting as a [[flight controller]]''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' and [[shield operator]],[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] when the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|Imperial shuttle]] ''[[ST 321]]'' began to approach the [[battle station]] after departing from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]''{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}} with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] on board. The [[shuttle]]'s [[pilot]], [[Captain]] [[Yorr]],{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/star-wars-x-wing-battle-over-endor-imperial-preview|text=Star Wars: X-Wing — Battle Over Endor Imperial Preview}} hailed Bean's station over [[Comm unit|comms]] and asked that the [[Death Star]]'s security [[Deflector shield|shield]] be deactivated so that they could land, providing [[Color|blue]] code clearance. Bean informed Yorr that the shield would be deactivated once there was confirmation of the code's transmission, and after a moment received it on the console while the [[Imperial officer]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Endicott]],{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Lieutenant Endicott|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11689265/2018-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-ROTJ-27-Lieutenant-Endicott}} who was overseeing the overbridge, watched over Bean's shoulder. Bean then flipped a switch that sent a signal down to the [[Death Star's shield generator]] on the [[moon]] [[Endor]], causing a section of the [[Space station|station's]] shield to be temporarily deactivated so that he could clear the [[Starship|shuttle]] to land in one of the station's [[hangar]]s. Endicott monitored the shuttle landing and then ordered Bean to inform the station's [[commander]], [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]], of Vader's arrival. Jerjerrod then greeted Vader personally as he disembarked. Bean at one point also stood in a [["Tulip" style Imperial work station|workstation]] on the overbridge while Jerjerrod stood on the floor before him.{{EncyclopediaCite|Battle Stations of the Empire and the First Order}} [[File:BeanJerjerrod-Encyclopedia.png|thumb|left|300px|Jad Bean served under Moff Tiaan Jerjerrod.]] After Vader's arrival, [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] soon arrived on the Death Star as well, and, lured in by his presence, the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] [[Battle of Endor|attacked]] the Death Star to try and eliminate Palpatine and the superweapon. Ultimately the Empire was bested by the Alliance, whose [[fleet]] destroyed the Death Star's [[reactor]] core, beginning a countdown to its destruction. Bean was among the Imperials that escaped from the destruction and survived the battle, although the Emperor [[Death|perished]], as did Endicott and Jerjerrod.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ===Bean of the First Order=== {{Quote|We follow in the tradition of Imperial TIE fighter pilots, whose primary weapons were a pair of Sienar Fleet Systems L-s1 laser cannons. Because some of you began your training using our older flight simulators, you know the Imperial TIE fighter cannons were state-of-the-art, but now, we might best describe them as serviceable. I don't say that with any disrespect to Imperial pilots, who fired those cannons as they flew bravely in starfighters that lacked even basic deflector shields. I merely want to emphasize that we have the advantage of technological advances in weapons, advances that our forebears could only dream of.|Jad Bean delivers a speech to Zeta Squadron|}} The rest of the Empire then [[Galactic Concordance|collapsed]] in [[5 ABY]] and, from its [[Imperial Remnants|remnants]], the [[First Order]] eventually formed to oppose the [[New Republic]], [[Declaration of a New Republic|successor]] to the Alliance.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Bean joined the First Order's [[First Order military|military]] and became a [[TIE series]] [[flight instructor]], also serving as [[Commanding officer|commander]] of [[Zeta Squadron]], with the [[callsign]] [[Zeta Leader]] and the nickname "Scorch."{{FFGXW2|set=TIE/fo Fighter Expansion Pack|cardname="Scorch"}} Initially considering the [[squadron]]'s members a gang of grunts, he spent [[Standard year|years]] training with them and did his best to transform them into a team of [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|pilots]]. When the time came for the squadron to fly its first official mission for the First Order, Bean gave the squadron members a speech in which he spoke in detail about the [[L-s9.6 laser cannon]]s of their [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s, but claimed that rather than the [[Laser cannon|cannons]], it was the pilots themselves who were the most important weapons. While flying for the First Order, Bean at one point piloted a [[TIE/se Bomber]] alongside two TIE/fos while chasing down an enemy vessel over a [[cloud]]y location.{{FFGXW2|set=Fury of the First Order Squadron Pack|cardname="Scorch"}} [[File:ScorchZetaLeader-SWZ.png|thumb|right|310px|Jad Bean flew against the Resistance for the First Order during the Siege of D'Qar.]] In [[34 ABY]], Zeta Squadron took part in{{FFGXW2|set=First Order Conversion Kit|cardname=Zeta Squadron Survivor}} the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]], in which the [[Resistance]] destroyed the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] superweapon. Humiliated and keen to prove their worth, the squadron then participated in the [[Battle of D'Qar]], in which a [[First Order Navy|First Order fleet]] attacked the Resistance as it evacuated from its [[Resistance base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]].''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' During the battle, Bean flew against the Resistance's [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber]]s, which were all eventually destroyed while targeting{{Film|VIII}} the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]'', although the [[dreadnought]] was destroyed as well. This allowed the Resistance to escape and survive to fight another [[Standard day|day]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|So which weapons are the most important? I'll make it easy for you. Take a good look at each other. Now, take a good look at yourselves. When you climb into your cockpit, and settle into your seat, and ease your finger close to the trigger on your control stick, know that the TIE fighter and its cannons are nothing without the instrument that makes them operational. You are that instrument. ''You'' are the weapon. Let's fly.|Jad Bean delivers a speech to Zeta Squadron|}} [[File:First_Order.svg|thumb|left|200px|Scorch was fanatically devoted to the First Order cause.]] Bean hated the Resistance and demonstrated a fanatical devotion to the First Order's cause even more extreme than most of its other pilots.{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2018/11/7/advanced-terror|text=Advanced Terror–Preview the TIE/fo Fighter Expansion Pack for X-Wing}} He did his best to train the members of Zeta Squadron, working with all of them, and was confident that all of them were competent with their vessels' laser cannons by the time they flew their first official mission. He considered the [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|pilots]] of the Empire brave, but believed that the [[L-s1 laser cannon]]s that they had used were only serviceable at best by the time he served the First Order given the advancement of technology. When delivering a speech to Zeta Squadron before its first mission, he went off book and told the pilots that they themselves were more dangerous than the weapons they used. Bean had light skin, green [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]]. ==Equipment== {{Quote|The First Order has provided us with Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems L-s9.6 laser cannons. I'm confident that you all know how to operate these cannons, upside down and with your eyes closed. The reason I'm confident is because it's my duty to make sure you can handle your laser cannons under any and all circumstances. So don't expect any last-minute pep talks or instructions from me about laser cannons. Because the fact is that your laser cannons are not the most important weapon at your disposal.|Jad Bean delivers a speech to Zeta Squadron|}} While on board the Death Star II, Bean wore a black fabric [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] including [[glove]]s and a [[belt]], as well as the distinctive [[helmet]] of an Imperial Navy trooper. While flying for the First Order, he wore a black [[flight suit]] and flew both a TIE/fo space superiority fighter and a [[Bomber|TIE/se Bomber]]. ==Behind the scenes== ===To Bean, or not to Bean=== {{Quote|Moon target in range. Sir, moon target in range now.''"
"''Commence firing.''"
"''Fire.|Jad Bean and Moff Tiaan Jerjerrod's dialogue in a deleted scene|audio=Bean-Jerjerrod-DeletedROTJ.flac|{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|scene=Jerjerrod's Conflict|nolink=1}}}} [[File:Jerjerrod-Bean-DeletedROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Jad Bean's scenes were filmed on Stage 7 at Elstree Studios.]] In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Jad Bean first appeared in [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] which released on [[May 25]], [[1983]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' The character was identified only as "Operator" in the script and was portrayed''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' uncredited by [[Stuart Fox]], who shot all of Bean's scenes on Stage 7 of [[Elstree Studios]] on [[April 1]], [[1982]], the last day of main stage shooting for the film in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]]. Fox also returned to provide automated dialogue replacement for the film at Mayflower Recording Studios in [[Wikipedia:London|London]] on [[January 25]], 1983. Bean appeared in additional scenes that did not make it into the final cut of the film. In the first of these scenes, Bean is stood in a workstation on the overbridge during the Battle of Endor when Jerjerrod is contacted by the Emperor with orders to destroy Endor should the Empire's [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator|shield generator]] there be destroyed. The Moff objects that there are still Imperial [[battalion]]s on the moon, but the Emperor repeats the order and Jerjerrod acquiesces before looking at Bean uneasily. [[File:Bean-DeletedROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Jad Bean was portrayed by Stuart Fox and appeared in a number of deleted scenes.]] In the second scene, Bean is still at the workstation when Endicott informs Jerjerrod that the bunker has been destroyed. The Moff pauses, then unhappily gives the order to position the station to destroy Endor, which Endicott relays to Bean as an order to commence rotation of the station's main batteries. In the final scene, Bean informs Jerjerrod from the workstation that the rebel fleet has moved to attack an unfinished portion of the Death Star. Jerjerrod orders him to concentrate all firepower on that sector, after which Bean begins to give a countdown until the Death Star is in position to destroy Endor. Once the station is in position, Jerjerrod does not respond, and Bean repeats himself before the Moff gives the order to commence firing and Bean complies. ===A tale of two Beans=== {{Quote|I knew instantly that this was not just some astonishing coincidence. I'm proud to say that author Ryder Windham and I are friends. We first connected years ago, when I had a website about Galoob's Star Wars Micro Machines toys. Ryder was a fellow fan of this oft-overlooked toy line. He reached out to me and provided information about his work on a pack-in mini-comic that was included with Galoob's Shadows of the Empire toys. (The Micro Machines site has since transformed into an active Facebook page.) Mere minutes after reading Eric's tweet, I called Ryder and thanked him profusely for this incredible surprise and honor. He revealed that he had sneaked it in as a tribute to a website I had run many years ago.|Jad Bean on Jad Bean|{{WebCite|url=http://www.jadbean.com/sergeant-jad-bean-an-officially-named-character-in-return-of-the-jedi.html|text=There is a character in Return of the Jedi named "Sergeant Jad Bean"|work=JadBean.com|archivedate=20220814063353|nolive=1}}}} [[File:ScorchBomber-XWM2.png|thumb|right|300px|Jad Bean has appeared on a number of ''X-Wing Miniatures Game'' cards.]] In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Bean appeared prior to the release of the film in its [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] by [[James Kahn]],[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]] which was released on [[May 12]], 1983. The character was then first identified in Legends in the [[2013]] reference book ''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]'', which was written by [[Ryder Windham]].''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]'' Windham snuck the character's name in as a tribute to his real-life friend Jad Bean, who had founded a website on [[Galoob]]'s [[Micro Machines Epic Collections]] series of toys and the [[Micro Machines|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' Micro Machines]] set that Windham had worked on. In the current ''Star Wars'' canon, a character with the Zeta Leader callsign was first introduced on a card in the ''[[TIE/fo Fighter Expansion Pack]]'' for the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]'' produced by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]{{FFGXW|set=TIE/fo Fighter Expansion Pack|cardname="Zeta Leader"}} and released on [[December 17]], [[2015]],{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/12/17/join-the-resistance|text=Join the Resistance}} although no connection to Bean was made. The nickname "Scorch" was then first used on [[November 7]], [[2018]], in a preview article for the [[TIE/fo Fighter Expansion Pack (Second Edition)|''TIE/fo Fighter Expansion Pack'']] released as part of Fantasy Flight Games' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]''. "Scorch" was revealed to be the nickname of Zeta Leader on a card in the expansion pack that was also included in the ''[[First Order Conversion Kit]]'' for the game, both of which released on [[December 13]], 2018.{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2018/12/13/happy-beeps|text=Happy Beeps}} Finally, the [[2019]] ''[[TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual]]'', another reference book written by Windham, first used the name Jad Bean in canon and [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the "Scorch" character as being Bean. ===Alternate Beans=== [[File:BeanSkins-SWSM.png|thumb|left|300px|Two decals are available for Jad Bean in ''Star Wars: Starfighter Missions''.]] In ''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'', an adaptation of ''Return of the Jedi'' written by [[Tom Angleberger]] and released on [[September 22]], 2015,{{Disney|subdomain=books|url=book/beware-the-power-of-the-dark-side|text=Beware the Power of the Dark Side!}} Bean is erroneously described as rushing to inform Endicott that Vader's shuttle has arrived. The lieutenant then orders a [[Petty Officer|petty officer]] rather than Bean to inform Jerjerrod of the [[Sith]]'s arrival while Bean returns to his chair. This conflicts with the events shown in the film itself. Bean is an unlockable character for the First Order faction in the [[2020]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'', in which two alternate cosmetic decals are available for the character's black TIE/fo space superiority fighter. The first skin gives the [[starfighter]] horizontal navy blue and light gray stripes, while the other adds turquoise coloring to the two central segments of each of the vehicle's wings and stripes of the same color running horizontally across the [[cockpit]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Jad Bean|imagecat=Images of Jad Bean}} *''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *''[[Return of the Jedi - The Film Novel]]'' *''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' {{Ab|Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!
